_comment: Configuration for `pnpm perf:xproc:gate` — see bench/xproc-gate.ts and docs/design/perf-gates.md.
_rounds: Rounds PER SHARD. CI runs 10 shards, so 200 rounds per case: chosen by the bootstrap power analysis in docs/design/perf-harness-interleaving.md: a 2% cost on every case is caught per case with median power above 0.98, and 0.64 on the noisiest.
_alpha: Per case. Twelve cases at 0.001 each keep the chance that identical code fails ANY case near 1%.
